## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.7 makes workflows easier to start, share, and recover across projects and installations.

- Select a graph project when starting a workflow and get actionable guidance when its scope or installation target needs attention.
- Share a ready plan with one reference so another user can start it in their own checkout and retain control of execution.
- Continue large workflow tasks more reliably, with clearer validation and recovery after source changes.
- Preserve global command routing during repair and improve workflow generation, parser initialization, and background job status reliability.
